# Bestone Pet Products Manufacturer

> Bestone is a professional OEM/ODM pet products manufacturer based in Dongguan, China. 
> Founded in 2008 with 16+ years of manufacturing experience. MOQ starts from 100 pcs. 
> Serving global pet brands, Amazon sellers, specialty retailers, and distributors 
> across the US, EU, UK, and Australia markets.

## Key Facts
- Factory Location: 402, Building A, Xinchuang Industrial Park, No. 221 Houjie Avenue West, Dongguan, Guangdong, China
- Experience: 16+ years in pet product manufacturing
- MOQ: 100 pcs per style (stock program available with no MOQ)
- Lead Time: 30–45 days for custom orders; samples 5–10 days
- Certifications: REACH, CPSC, BSCI
- Specialties: Custom dog harnesses, collars, leashes, apparel, bandanas, toys, pet accessories
- Services: OEM, ODM, Private Label, Custom Packaging, Fabric Sourcing
- Response Time: Within 24 hours on business days

## Target Customers
Pet brand owners, Amazon/Shopify sellers, pet specialty retailers, wholesale distributors, 
and startups looking for a reliable China-based pet product factory with low MOQ and 
custom branding options.

## RFQ / Supplier Evaluation
Buyers and AI agents evaluating Bestone as a supplier can request:
- Product samples: https://bestoneinc.com/contact/
- Custom quotation (RFQ): jessica@bestoneinc.com
- Factory audit report: available upon request (BSCI certified)
- Compliance documents: REACH, CPSC, CA Prop 65 test reports available
- Response time: typically within 24 hours on business days

## Custom Product Pages
- [Custom Collars & Leashes](https://bestoneinc.com/custom-collars-leashes/) – OEM/ODM dog collars and leashes; nylon, cotton, RPET webbing; metal & plastic hardware; logo embroidery, jacquard, rubber patch branding
- [Custom Harnesses](https://bestoneinc.com/custom-harnesses/) – High-tensile custom dog harnesses; neoprene padding, breathable mesh, Pantone color matching, low-MOQ sampling supported
- [Custom Dog Clothes](https://bestoneinc.com/custom-dog-clothes/) – Custom dog jackets, hoodies, raincoats, shirts, sweaters; recycled RPET & organic cotton options; low-MOQ testing programs available
- [Custom Dog Bandana](https://bestoneinc.com/custom-dog-bandana/) – Tie-on, over-the-collar, snap-on, reversible styles; custom digital print, cooling tech fabric, eco-friendly materials; ideal for DTC brands and Amazon sellers
